skill.name: django-pro
skill.description: Guide Django 5.x development with architecture, ORM optimization, DRF, async views, Celery, Channels, testing, security, and deployment practices.
skill.summary: Get expert Django 5.x guidance for scalable web applications, APIs, background tasks, and production deployment.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static external command finding is a false positive. The flagged SKILL.md line only formats a resource path in Markdown backticks, and the skill contains prompt guidance rather than executable code.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The line uses Markdown backticks around a documentation path, not Ruby or shell command execution. SKILL.md is prompt text with no executable script or command invocation at this location.

content.value_statement: Django projects can become slow, insecure, or hard to maintain as they grow. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward scalable architecture, optimized queries, tests, and deployment patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains Django 5.x architecture choices for apps, settings, services, and reusable modules.
Guides ORM optimization with indexes, select_related, prefetch_related, annotations, and query review.
Supports DRF API design, authentication patterns, permissions, serializers, and test planning.
Advises on async views, Channels, Celery tasks, caching, and background processing.
Reviews security concerns such as CSRF, CORS, authentication, permissions, and SQL injection prevention.
Suggests deployment patterns for ASGI, WSGI, static files, environment settings, and monitoring.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, but it does not inspect a live application unless files are supplied.
It cannot verify runtime performance without logs, query plans, or profiling data.
It may need project context before recommending schema changes or migrations.
It does not replace security review for regulated or high-risk production systems.

use_cases.title: Optimize a Growing Django App
use_cases.description: Identify query, caching, and architecture changes that improve performance without changing product behavior.

use_cases.title: Design Reliable Django APIs
use_cases.description: Plan DRF serializers, permissions, authentication, tests, and versioning for maintainable API development.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Production Deployment
use_cases.description: Review settings, static files, background workers, ASGI or WSGI choices, and monitoring before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Django View
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Django view for clarity and correctness. Explain any issues in simple terms and suggest safer Django patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Improve ORM Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these models and querysets for N+1 queries and missing indexes. Recommend Django ORM changes and explain the expected impact.

prompt_templates.title: Design a DRF API
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a DRF API for this feature. Include serializers, permissions, authentication choices, tests, and migration risks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Scalable Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production Django architecture for this application. Cover app boundaries, services, Celery, Channels, caching, deployment, and observability.

output_examples.input: User asks for help fixing slow Django list pages.
output: Identifies likely N+1 query sources and recommends select_related or prefetch_related.
Suggests indexes for frequent filters and ordering.
Lists tests and profiling steps to verify the improvement.

output_examples.input: User wants a DRF authentication design.
output: Compares session, token, JWT, and OAuth options for the use case.
Recommends permission classes and object-level checks.
Highlights refresh token, logout, and audit logging concerns.

output_examples.input: User is preparing a Django application for production.
output_examples.output: A deployment readiness review covering settings, static assets, workers, database connections, security headers, monitoring, and rollback planning.

best_practices: Share models, settings, queries, and constraints before asking for architecture changes.
Ask for tests and migration plans when changing database behavior.
Validate recommendations with profiling, Django checks, and project-specific test suites.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad rewrites without providing current project structure and constraints.
Do not accept raw SQL suggestions without parameterization and migration review.
Do not deploy performance changes without measuring query counts and response times.

faq.question: Can this skill help with Django 5.x projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on Django 5.x patterns, including async views, ORM usage, DRF, Celery, Channels, and deployment.

faq.question: Does it generate complete Django code?
faq.answer: It can help draft code when given context, but the skill itself is guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it optimize database queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review querysets, relationships, indexes, annotations, and caching strategies when relevant project details are provided.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production security work?
faq.answer: It highlights Django security practices, but critical systems still need expert review, testing, and operational controls.

faq.question: Does it support Django REST Framework?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers serializers, permissions, authentication, viewsets, testing, and API design tradeoffs.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide models, views, serializers, settings, error messages, performance data, and deployment constraints when available.
